project.name: Student Notes Hub
project.description: A platform where students can upload school notes, share them with other students, and discuss them in comments.
project.problem: Students duplicate effort re-typing notes and there is no shared place to discuss them.
successCriteria: A student can upload a note and another student can comment on it
userStories: As a student, I can upload a PDF note and share it with my class.

features.name: Accounts
features.description: Students sign up and manage their notes.

requirements.title: Users can upload PDF notes
requirements.description: A user can upload a PDF note file and it is stored.

requirements.title: Users can comment on shared notes
requirements.description: Authorized users can add discussion comments.

requirements.title: Private notes are only accessible to authorized users

decisions.reason: Notes, users, and comments are relational.

assumptions.statement: Only registered users can upload notes.
assumptions.reason: The user asked for user-owned notes.

architecture.fileStorage: Object storage for uploaded note files.

security.accessControl: Users can only access and comment on notes they are allowed to view.
security.sensitiveData: Uploaded files and account credentials are stored securely.

acceptanceCriteria: A student can upload a note and another student can comment on it
